Who sees what
Obscura: the relay and your account
Sees your IP address, account number and payments. Cannot read your traffic: it is encrypted for the exit.
Mullvad: the exit
Sees the sites you visit and your DNS queries. Does not see your IP address or your account: only the relay talks to it.
Ombra, this app
Has no servers, no analytics and no trackers. Only the VPN core talks to the network.
No single company sees both who you are and what you do. To link the two, Obscura and Mullvad would have to work together.

string-array.name: tips
string-array.item: Test all protocols in the same place, with the same exit city, the screen on, the phone not charging, battery saver off and other VPNs off.
Speed should come close to plain WireGuard. Stealth needs more processor time. TCP/TLS is the slowest.
Do 5 rounds, with the protocols in a random order in each round. Compare the middle result (the median), not the best one.
Test download and upload apart. With Stealth, the upload in the first 10 seconds can be lower than later.
Test once on Wi-Fi and once on mobile data. Write down the signal strength.
Turn packet padding off for a fair test: it costs upload bandwidth.
If you can, use your own iperf3 server. Public speed test servers can be busy or limit the speed.
